intro: Sudan is at war, with the army and the RSF each controlling large parts of the country.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: The army, led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, controls the east and centre, including Khartoum, which it retook in 2025. The RSF, led by Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo ('Hemedti'), controls most of Darfur, where it captured El Fasher in late 2025. Both sides are accused of serious abuses.

chapters.title: Peace efforts
text: Several countries have tried to broker ceasefires.

keyTerms.meaning: An armed force organised like an army but separate from it.
